units.source_text: 源氏公子吩咐，请僧众再作法事，祈求佛佑。

en.t: Prince Genji gave orders for the monks to perform further rites and pray for the Buddha's protection.

units.source_text: 告别之前，教惟光点个纸烛[\[8\]](#part1333.html#m8)，仔细看看夕颜花的人家送他的那把扇子，

en.t: Before taking his leave, he had Koremitsu light a paper torch and carefully examined the fan sent to him from the house of the evening faces,

units.source_text: 但觉用这把扇子的人的衣香芬芳扑鼻，教人怜爱。

en.t: and he felt that the fragrance clinging to the robes of the person who had used it was sweet and striking, stirring tender affection.

units.source_text: 扇面上潇洒活泼地写着两句诗：

en.t: On the face of the fan, two lines of verse were written in a graceful, lively hand:
